facts.fact: La Poste Tunisienne provides free e-Dinar wallets and the D17 app for remote payments, used by about 1,568,000 pupils for 2026-27 school registration (La Presse de Tunisie).

Parents paid school registration fees remotely through La Poste Tunisienne e-Dinar wallets and D17, and about 287,300 students (about 76%) completed remote university registration by electronic payment by end-September 2026.
